metadata.radial_profile: zero-stress neutral Kerr-Newman Page-Thorne relative flux outside ISCO; exact azimuthal mean, peak=1

flow.outer_motion: normalized circular four-velocity plus comoving radial tetrad boost; prescribed alpha(H/r)^2 ZAMO circular-speed scaling
flow.plunge_motion: neutral equatorial timelike geodesic with E,L fixed by the finite-drift ISCO launch; Carter constant zero
flow.frequency_shift: g=1/[u^t-lambda*u^phi-(k_r/E)*u^r]; forward covariant photon k_r retained with its radial sign
flow.streamline_coordinate: age and accumulated azimuth relative to ISCO; t-age(r) and phi-azimuth(r) advect along flow
flow.streamline_quadrature: cumulative trapezoid on separate exterior geometric and inner log(r-r+) grids; float64 linear lookup
flow.event_horizon: no emission or timelike emitter is defined on or inside r+

sources.role: Kerr-Newman metric and neutral timelike first integrals
neutral Kerr-Newman inspiral/plunge equations and interpretation
motivation only for the prescribed alpha(H/r)^2 radial drift scaling

metadata.perturbation: positive, analytically mean-normalized localized angular packets on several radial scales, plus a coherent m2 logarithmic spiral; no axisymmetric rings
metadata.angular_kernel: K_n(theta)=(1+cos(theta))^n/[binomial(2n,n)/2^n]; positive, unit mean, finite degree n
metadata.kernel_blending: convex mixtures of degrees1,2,4,8,12; broad packets capped at4; highest active angular degree follows a birth-parcel angular-advection cadence guide
metadata.sampling_bandwidth: 0.99*pi/[1.02*max_future_abs(Omega)*dt_frame]; nine characteristic times per50t_g parcel lifetime; 240 unique frames/cycle; smooth positive-kernel blending, gas frequencies unchanged
metadata.sampling_limit: angular guide only, not a bound on every temporal frequency; radial transport, birth crossfades, retardation and changing viewpoint require separate temporal convergence checks
metadata.normalization: M=(1+C*sum_j w_j*K_j)/(1+C*sum_j w_j), with nonnegative radial weights and unit-mean positive kernels; current/previous fields crossfade convexly
metadata.advection: r_birth=age^-1(age(r)-birth_age); backward along the same normalized outer drift and neutral geodesic plunge used in photon frequency shifts
metadata.coherence_choice: phenomenological finite lifetime, about a few bright inner orbits; not a calculated MRI correlation time
metadata.birth_blending: current and previous births, complementary sin^2/cos^2 windows; continuous first time derivative
metadata.periodicity: seeded field births repeat every loop_period_tg; gas orbital frequencies are not quantized
metadata.emission_time_rule: t_em=t_obs-delay_tg separately at each photon/source event
metadata.azimuthal_mean: exactly background profile at fixed radius and emitted time, since every perturbation has integer m>=1
metadata.plunge_emissivity: separate prescribed weak heating: plunge_peak_fraction*(1-x)^2, x=(r-rplus)/(rISCO-rplus); zero value/slope at ISCO, finite exterior limit at horizon; no source on/inside horizon
metadata.horizon: no source on or inside rplus; no boundary glow; g^4, photon delays and capture applied by renderer
metadata.surface_emission: identical isotropic thin equatorial source on both sides; optical-depth handling specified by tracer
metadata.dimensional_normalization: none; mass, accretion rate, temperature and spectrum unspecified
illustrative_prescriptions: finite-lived multiscale emissivity packets and a logarithmic spiral
periodic births used to construct an eight-second loop

sources.role: Page-Thorne stationary thin-disk conservation integral outside ISCO
motivation for advected and shearing brightness structures; not that paper's specific source model
methodology of time-dependent nonaxisymmetric equatorial sources with per-image retarded times; not the AART stochastic solver

scope: Declared bounded emission, exact exterior azimuthal mean, characteristic advection and retarded times; not GRMHD or plasma-heating validation
